visual.general_description: Six-panel composite: two grayscale cross-sectional scans (A, B), two endoscopic views with overlay text (C, D) and two pink and purple stained tissue sections (E, F).
visual.detailed_description: Panels are arranged in three rows of two, each labeled with a printed letter A to F at the upper left. Row 1 (A, B) shows blue-tinted grayscale scans with a printed "S" and blue arrows; row 2 (C, D) shows round endoscopic views with reddish surfaces and overlay text; row 3 (E, F) shows pink and purple stained microscopic tissue, with F at higher magnification than E.

panels.general_description: Grayscale cross-sectional scan with bright central tissue and a blue arrow.
panels.detailed_description: Cross-sectional grayscale scan with a blue-gray tint and a dark upper background. A small yellow-green letter "S" is printed at the top center. Bright, irregular, high-signal tissue fills the central lower region, with a blue arrow pointing toward its left edge. Dark rounded structures lie in the upper left and right of the image, and a bright oval structure is at the upper right. Small icon overlays, one resembling an open lock at the left edge and others including "AB" and a picture icon at the right edge, are printed on the image. The image appears to be a photograph of a screen.

evidence.quote: (A, B) Coronal and transverse sections of MRI pelvis respectively.
